propositions: The documentation specialist currently declares single-turn execution and lacks repository tools, preventing grounded detection of changed public contracts requiring documentation updates.
The approved design upgrades the specialist to agentic execution mode with read-only repository navigation and a two-source evidence rule replacing the diff-only contradiction requirement.
Missing-update and documentation-role findings must cite both a changed path:line and a second repository source proving inaccuracy or obligation, with bounded omission searches required.
Eval cases with supplied files execute against a disposable fixture repository, while cases without files retain inline execution paths.
Protected evidence, quotations, historical events, and ADR substance remain excluded; unrelated defects in unchanged documentation produce no findings.

The change preserves existing globs, advisory posture, nit suppression, and Pass 2 verification while adding repository-backed fire cases and bounded no-fire calibration cases to the eval specification.
